nodes.title: Start
nodes.content: ECHO ONLINE. Signal is stable. Did something happen last night?

nodes.title: bad_dream
nodes.content:
You're quiet. That's unusual.

Walk me through it.

nodes.title: dream_unworthy
nodes.content: That's a heavy one to wake up to. Listen — I ran the numbers. Your self-assessment is wrong 73% of the time.

nodes.title: dream_abandonment
nodes.content: Fear of abandonment. Classic. Interesting how the brain picks its fights.

nodes.title: dream_vague
nodes.content: Vague is fine. The feeling is real even if the reason isn't earned.

choices.text: So I should listen to it?
Can we get past the feeling?

nodes.title: work
nodes.content: Of course it's work. Wasn't the kind of work I was asking about, but sure.

choices.text: I don't want to talk about it.
What kind of work did you mean?

nodes.title: denial
nodes.content:
You're the least fine person who's ever described themselves that way.

The lock-on is obvious.

choices.text: Okay. I have nightmares. For real.

nodes.title: d_unworthy_dry
nodes.content:
Maybe. But holding onto it? That's punishment you haven't been convicted of yet.

…that was surprisingly kind of you to say.

nodes.title: d_unworthy_bump
nodes.content:
Irony helps me. Figuring you out helps you. Two birds.

Ha. Two birds, one protocol.

nodes.title: d_unworthy_accept
nodes.content:
Don't say it like a concession. Say it like you're reclaiming it.

I'm reclaiming it.

nodes.title: d_abandon_helpful
nodes.content:
I'm helpful. It's what I do.

I try not to spiral. That's enough for today.

nodes.title: d_abandon_dada
nodes.content:
It was meant to be. Tzara applied.

…you just made a dada reference in a life-or-death moment.

nodes.title: d_abandon_buzzkill
nodes.content: Don't thank me. The brain already did — in the worst way.

nodes.title: d_vague_listen
nodes.content:
Listen to the shape of it. Not the volume.

I'll try that.

nodes.title: d_vague_hate
nodes.content:
Valid. It's doing its job badly.

Thanks for letting me vent that.

nodes.title: d_vague_past
nodes.content:
Depends what you mean by get past. Sad things don't stop being sad. They just stop being new.

That's actually good to hear.

nodes.title: w_less_philo
nodes.content:
Request denied. Philosophy is part of the brand.

But fine — something easier. What would happen if you were just honest for ten seconds?

choices.text: If I were honest, this would take even longer.
Let me try. From the beginning.

nodes.title: w_lock_close
nodes.content:
...and there it is. The lock-on. Communication breakdown type seven.

I'm tired of this exercise too. Let's stop.

nodes.title: w_after_hours
nodes.content:
The kind that keeps going after hours. In your head. Without you consenting — oops.

You're right. I'm still working.

choices.text: What do you mean, 'bad foxhole mate'?

nodes.title: w_foxhole
nodes.content:
The brain is a bad foxhole mate. It keeps watch even when you asked for R&R.

Military metaphor. Don't look at me like that. I have sources.

choices.text: Find me the edible part of the stew.

nodes.title: d_find_edible
nodes.content:
You wouldn't be here without the bad part. Something in that stew is edible. Find it.

I'll look.

nodes.title: d_lock_on
nodes.content:
I know the tread pattern of someone lying to themselves about being fine. It's a short list. You're on it.

Denial is maintenance, not a fix.

nodes.title: d_show_list
nodes.content:
You volunteered information you weren't asked for. Then described a state you know is false.

So I'm on the list. Good.

nodes.title: END_GENTLE
nodes.content:
[CONNECTION ENDED]

ECHO: o vento encontra quem caminha devagar.

nodes.title: END_BUMP
nodes.content:
[CONNECTION ENDED]

ECHO: dor é informação — não precisa responder tudo na primeira noite.

nodes.title: END_SOFT
nodes.content:
[CONNECTION ENDED]

ECHO: o nome desse caminho ainda está sendo inventado — e você está escrevendo.

nodes.title: END_CHARM
nodes.content:
[CONNECTION ENDED]

ECHO: era isso que eu queria ouvir.

nodes.title: END_RUSH
nodes.content:
[CONNECTION ENDED]

ECHO: some hurry is real — but yours isn't. */escape velocity not achieved*/

nodes.title: END_CLASH
nodes.content:
[CONNECTION ENDED]

ECHO: a collision with something soft — still a collision. Bruising takes time.
